name: Papa le moroho
subtitle: Papa le moroho is stiff maize-meal porridge (papa) eaten with moroho, cooked green leafy vegetables.

facts.label: Name

parts.text: Papa le moroho is stiff maize-meal porridge (papa) eaten with moroho, cooked green leafy vegetables. Moroho is the Sesotho word for leafy vegetables, which can include young leaves, succulent stems, flowers and very young fruits; a 2023 review counted 90 wild plants the Basotho use as vegetables.

In a survey of Basotho women, stiff maize porridge was eaten with all meals, often with moroho; homemade stiff porridge was eaten far more often in rural than urban areas, where bought porridge was more common.
